sanskrit: takṣadyadī manaso venato vāgjyeṣṭhasya dharmaṃ dyukṣoranīke . ādīmāyanvaramā vāvaśānā juṣṭaṃ patiṃ kalaśe gāva indum
english: When the speech of the mind's beloved, foremost in excellence, fashions the law on the shining front, then the eager cows, longing, come along to the bowl, to Soma their beloved lord.

sanskrit: sākamukṣo marjayanta svasāro daśa dhīrasya dhītayo dhanutrīḥ . hariḥ paryadravajjāḥ sūryasya droṇaṃ nanakṣe atyo na vājī
english: Together the ten sisters, the thoughts of the wise one, cleanse the bull as they flow onward. The golden one ran around, the offspring of the Sun; like a swift steed he entered the trough.

sanskrit: adhi yadasminvājinīva śubhaḥ spardhante dhiyaḥ sūre na viśaḥ . apo vṛṇānaḥ pavate kavīyanvrajaṃ na paśuvardhanāya manma
english: When upon him, gleaming like a prize-winning mare, the inspired thoughts contend as peoples around the sun, he flows choosing the waters, seeking wisdom, for a thought that enlarges the herd like an enclosure.

sanskrit: indurvājī pavate gonyoghā indre somaḥ saha invanmadāya . hanti rakṣo bādhate paryarātiṃ varivaskṛṇvanvṛjanasya rājā
english: The swift Indu flows, the flood that yields the cow; Soma exhilarates Indra together for rapture. He slays the demon, drives away all hostility, creating wide space — he is the king of the stronghold.

sanskrit: ayā pavā pavasvainā vasūni māṃścatva indro sarasi pra dhanva . braghnaścidyasya vāto na jūtiṃ purumedhāścittakave naraṃ dhāt
english: With this purifying stream, flow, bringing these treasures; Indra has drunk deeply and sped to the lake. Even the tawny one, whose impulse is like the wind, the much-wise one places a man for the discerning.

sanskrit: mahattatsomo mahiṣaścakārāpāṃ yadgarbho 'vṛṇīta devān . adadhādindre pavamāna ojo 'janayatsūrye jyotirinduḥ
english: Great is what Soma the mighty buffalo did when, the embryo of the waters, he chose the gods. The purifying Indu placed might in Indra; he begot light in the Sun.

sanskrit: asarji vakvā rathyo yathājau dhiyā manotā prathamā manīṣa . daśa svasāro adhi sāno avye mṛjanti vahniṃ sadaneṣvaccha
english: He was released, the eloquent one, like a chariot-horse in battle — the foremost wisdom shaped by thought and mind. The ten sisters on the back of the sheep cleanse the carrier toward the seats.

sanskrit: apāmivedūrmayastartturāṇāḥ pra manīṣā īrate somamaccha . namasyantīrupa ca yanti saṃ cāca viśantyuśatīruśantam
english: Like the surging waves of the waters rushing forward, the inspired thoughts set Soma in motion. Reverently they approach him, come together and enter — the longing ones entering him who longs.

sanskrit: purojitī vo andhasaḥ sutāya mādayitnave . apa śvānaṃ śnathiṣṭana sakhāyo dīrghajihvyam
english: As forerunners for your pressed drink, the inebriating Soma, O friends, pierce and drive away the long-tongued dog.

sanskrit: ayaṃ pūṣā rayirbhagaḥ somaḥ punāno arṣati . patirviśvasya bhūmano vyakhyadrodasī ubhe
english: This Soma, Pūṣan, wealth, and Bhaga, flows along purifying himself. Lord of all existence, he looks out upon both worlds.

sanskrit: sutāso madhumattamāḥ somā indrāya mandinaḥ . pavitravanto akṣarandevāngacchantu vo madāḥ
english: The pressed Somas, most full of sweetness, gladdening for Indra, flow purified through the filter. May your ecstasies go to the gods.

sanskrit: somāḥ pavanta indavo 'smabhyaṃ gātuvittamāḥ . mitrāḥ svānā arepasaḥ svādhyaḥ svarvidaḥ
english: The Somas, the drops, flow purified for us, most knowing of the path. Friendly, well-pressed, unblemished, sweetly meditating, finding the sun.

sanskrit: abhī no vājasātamaṃ rayimarṣa śataspṛham . indo sahasrabharṇasaṃ tuvidyumnaṃ vibhāsaham
english: Flow toward us the most prize-winning wealth, coveted by hundreds, O Indu — of a thousand forms, of mighty splendor, overpowering with brilliance.

sanskrit: abhī navante adruhaḥ priyamindrasya kāmyam . vatsaṃ na pūrva āyuni jātaṃ rihanti mātaraḥ
english: They celebrate the beloved, the desired of Indra, who does no harm. As mothers lick a newborn calf in its first life, so they tend him.

sanskrit: ā haryatāya dhṛṣṇave dhanuṣṭanvanti pauṃsyam . śukrā vi yantyasurāya nirṇije vipāmagre mahīyuvaḥ
english: For the beloved bold one they stretch out manhood like a bow. The bright ones go forth for the mighty lord's gleaming robe, the great ones honoring the sage foremost.

sanskrit: pari tyaṃ haryataṃ hariṃ babhruṃ punanti vāreṇa . yo devānviśvāṃ itpari madena saha gacchati
english: They purify with the fleece that beloved, tawny, brown Soma, who goes around all the gods together with his rapture.

sanskrit: pra sunvānāsyāndhaso marto na vaṣṭa tadvacaḥ . apa śvānamarādhasaṃ hatā makhaṃ na bhṛgavaḥ
english: Of the one being pressed, of his drink, no mortal craves that speech. Drive away the ungrateful dog; smite the arrogant one as the Bhṛgus did.

sanskrit: ā sūryasya bṛhato bṛhannadhi rathaṃ viṣvañcamaruhadvicakṣaṇaḥ
english: Upon the great chariot of the great Sun, the all-seeing one mounted, spreading in all directions.

sanskrit: acodaso no dhanvantvindavaḥ pra svānāso bṛhaddeveṣu harayaḥ . vi cidaśnānā iṣayo arātayo 'ryo naḥ santu saniṣantu no dhiyaḥ
english: May the drops, the Indus, urged onward press forward for us; the tawny ones, well-pressed, lofty among the gods. Let the eager energies conquer even the hostile ones; may they be friendly to us and win our inspired thoughts.

sanskrit: eṣa pra kośe madhumāṃ acikradadindrasya vajro vapuṣo vapuṣṭamaḥ . abhyR^ī3tasya sudughā ghṛtaścuto vāśrā arṣanti payasā ca ghenavaḥ
english: This sweet one roars forward in the bowl, Indra's thunderbolt, most wondrous of wonders. The good milch-cows, dripping with ghee, flowing for him who is approaching, roar and rush with their milk.

sanskrit: pro ayāsīdindurindrasya niṣkṛtaṃ sakhā sakhyurna pra mināti saṅgiram . marya iva yuvatibhiḥ samarṣati somaḥ kalaśe śatayāmanā pathā
english: Indu has gone forth to Indra's appointed place; as a friend to a friend he does not diminish their shared speech. Like a young man with maidens, Soma flows together in the bowl by the hundredfold-traveled path.

sanskrit: dhartā divaḥ pavate kṛtvyo raso dakṣo devānāmanumādyo nṛbhiḥ . hariḥ sṛjāno atyo na satvabhirvṛthā pājāṃsi kṛṇuṣe nadīṣvā
english: The supporter of heaven flows, the active essence, the power to be celebrated by men among the gods. Released, the tawny one like a swift horse among heroes freely makes his displays in the rivers.

sanskrit: vṛṣā matīnāṃ pavate vicakṣaṇaḥ somo ahnāṃ pratarītoṣasāṃ divaḥ . prāṇā sindhūnāṃ kalaśāṃ acikradadindrasya hārdyāviśanmanīṣibhiḥ
english: The all-seeing bull of inspired thoughts, Soma, flows purified — the extender of days, of dawns, of heaven. He has roared into the bowls, the breath of the rivers, entering into Indra's heart with the wise ones.

sanskrit: trirasmai sapta dhenavo duduhrire satyāmāśiraṃ parame vyomani . catvāryanyā bhuvanāni nirṇije cārūṇi cakre yadṛtairavardhata
english: Three times the seven cows milked for him the true mixture in the highest heaven. Four other worlds he fashioned for his gleaming robe when he grew great with the rites.

sanskrit: indrāya soma suṣutaḥ pari sravāpāmīvā bhavatu rakṣasā saha . mā te rasasya matsata dvayāvino draviṇasvanta iha santvindavaḥ
english: O Soma, well-pressed, flow all around for Indra; let disease be gone, together with the demon. May the deceitful ones not enjoy your essence; let the drops be here for the wealthy devotees.

sanskrit: asāvi somo aruṣo vṛṣā harī rājeva dasmo abhi gā acikradat . punāno vāramatyeṣyavyayaṃ śyeno na yoniṃ ghṛtavantamāsadat
english: Soma the ruddy bull, the tawny pair, has been pressed; like a skillful king he has roared toward the cows. Purifying himself, he will pass through the eternal fleece; like a falcon he has sat in the ghee-rich womb.

sanskrit: pra devamacchā madhumanta indavo 'siṣyadanta gāva ā na dhenavaḥ . barhiṣado vacanāvanta ūdhabhiḥ parisrutamusriyā nirṇijaṃ dhire
english: The sweet drops have flowed toward the god, they have flowed like milch-cows to a gathering. Seated on the sacred grass, the divine cows with their udders, they assumed the garment of the flowing dawn-cow.

sanskrit: añjate vyañjate samañjate kratuṃ rihanti maghvābhyañjate . sindhoru 'cchvāse patayantamukṣaṇaṃ hiraṇyapāvāḥ paśumapsu gṛbhṇate
english: They anoint, they anoint distinctly, they anoint together; they lick the will; they anoint with richness. Those with golden purifiers seize the bull flying in the swelling breath of the river, the animal in the waters.

sanskrit: pavitraṃ te vitataṃ brahmaṇaspate prabhurgātrāṇi paryeṣi viśvataḥ . ataptatanūrna tadāmo aśnute śṛtāsa idvahantaḥ saṃ tadāśata
english: Your filter is spread out, O Lord of Prayer; mighty, you encompass the limbs from all sides. One whose body has not been heated, the raw one, does not attain that — only the well-cooked who carry it fully reach that.

sanskrit: śruṣṭe jātāsa indavaḥ svarvidaḥ
english: Born to be heard, the drops, the Indus, are finders of the sun.

sanskrit: pra dhanvā soma jāgṛvirindrāyendo pari srava . dyumantaṃ śuṣmamā bhara svarvidam
english: Speed forward, O Soma, wakeful; O Indu, flow all around for Indra. Bring the brilliant vital force, the finder of the sun.

sanskrit: sakhāya ā ni ṣīdata punānāya pra gāyata . śiśuṃ na yajñaiḥ pari bhūṣata śriye
english: Friends, sit down; sing forth for the purifying one. Adorn him like a child with sacrificial rites for splendor.

sanskrit: taṃ vaḥ sakhāyo madāya punānamabhi gāyata . śiśuṃ na havyaiḥ svadayanta gūrtibhiḥ
english: Friends, sing toward him, the purifying one, for your rapture. Sweetening him like a child with oblations and with praises.

sanskrit: prāṇā śiśurmahīnāṃ hinvannṛtasya dīdhitim . viśvā pari priyā bhuvadadha dvitā
english: The child of the great ones breathes, urging forward the shining thought of Order. He became beloved of all, then twofold.

sanskrit: pavasva devavītaya indo dhārābhirojasā . ā kalaśaṃ madhumāntsoma naḥ sadaḥ
english: Flow pure for the pleasure of the gods, O Indu, with your streams of might. Fill the bowl, O sweet Soma, our seat.

sanskrit: somaḥ punāna ūrmiṇāvyaṃ vāraṃ vi dhāvati . agre vācaḥ pavamānaḥ kanikradat
english: Soma, purifying himself with his wave, courses through the woolen filter. The purifying one, roaring aloud, goes at the forefront of speech.

sanskrit: pra punānāya vedhase somāya vaca ucyate . bhṛtiṃ na bharā matibhirjujoṣate
english: Speech is uttered forth for the purifying, wise Soma. Like one bringing a burden, he delights with inspired thoughts.

sanskrit: gomanna indo aśvavatsutaḥ sudakṣa dhaniva . śuciṃ ca varṇamadhi goṣu dhārya
english: Like one rich in cattle and horses, O Indu, pressed forth, O skillful one, like a bowman — sustain your pure bright hue among the cows.

sanskrit: asmabhyaṃ tvā vasuvidamabhi vāṇīranūṣata . gobhiṣṭe varṇamabhi vāsayāmasi
english: The voices have sounded toward you for us, the finder of wealth. We clothe your bright hue with the cows' streams.

sanskrit: pavate haryato harirati hvarāṃsi raṃhyā . abhyarṣa stotṛbhyo vīravadyaśaḥ
english: The beloved tawny one flows, moving swiftly past the crooked places with speed. Flow toward the praisers, glory rich in heroes.

sanskrit: pari kośaṃ madhuścutaṃ somaḥ punāno arṣati . abhi vāṇīrṛṣīṇāṃ saptā nūṣata
english: Soma flows purifying himself around the honey-dripping bowl. The seven voices of the seers have sounded toward him.

sanskrit: mahi dyukṣatamo madaḥ
english: Great is the most heavenly rapture.

sanskrit: abhi dyumnaṃ bṛhadyaśa iṣaspate didīhi deva devayum . vi kośaṃ madhyamaṃ yuva
english: Shine forth, O lord of impulses, of great fame and splendor, O god, god-seeking. Split open the middle bowl, O young one.

sanskrit: ā sotā pari ṣiñcatāśvaṃ na stomamapturaṃ rajasturam . vanaprakṣamudaprutam
english: Let the pressers pour around, like a swift horse, the praise that is nimble, crossing the atmosphere, dripping through the wood, swelling with the waters.

sanskrit: etamu tyaṃ madacyutaṃ sahasradhāraṃ vṛṣabhaṃ divoduham . viśvā vasūni bibhratam
english: This one, who causes rapture to flow, with a thousand streams, the bull that milks heaven, bearing all good things.

sanskrit: sa sunve yo vasūnāṃ yo rāyāmānetā ya iḍānām . somo yaḥ sukṣitīnām
english: He is pressed who is the bringer of riches, of wealth, of refreshments — the Soma who belongs to those who dwell well.

sanskrit: tvaṃ hyā3ṅga daivyā pavamāna janimāni dyumattamaḥ . amṛtatvāya ghoṣayan
english: For you indeed, O purifying one, are the most brilliant of divine births, proclaiming for the sake of immortality.

sanskrit: eṣa sya dhārayā suto 'vyo vārebhiḥ pavate madintamaḥ . krīḍannūrmirapāmiva
english: This one, pressed forth, flows most intoxicating with the streams, through the woolen filters, playing like a wave of the waters.

sanskrit: ya usriyā api yā antaraśmani nirgā akṛntadojasā . abhi vrajaṃ tatniṣe gavyamaśvyaṃ varmīva dhṛṣṇavā ruja . Oṃ varmīva dhṛṣṇavā ruja
english: He who with his might cut free the dawn-cows and those hidden within the rock. You have stretched toward the enclosure rich in cattle and horses — break it boldly like armor. Oṃ — break it boldly like armor.
